topic: India Dispatches Life-Saving Medicines to Bolivia
headline: INDIA SENDS 8 TONNES OF LIFE-SAVING MEDICINES TO BOLIVIA TO STRENGTHEN ITS HEALTHCARE SYSTEM
summary: India has dispatched eight metric tonnes of essential and life-saving medicines to Bolivia to strengthen its healthcare system. This aid is part of India's efforts to support Bolivia during a challenging time. The medicines are intended to provide critical care to patients in need. The shipment is a significant gesture of support from India to Bolivia.
